name: zt_ci_job_context
title: Zero trust CI job context
description: CI jobs that ran on one runner pod in the last 24 hours, the one overlapping the incident first: project, pipeline, job id, name and stage, merge request id, title and URL, author, commit, script, status, failure reason and times. pod is the runner pod name, for example ci-runner-7d9f8-xk2lq.

pod.description: Runner pod name, for example ci-runner-7d9f8-xk2lq

execution.template: | savedsearch "ZT Agent - CI Job Context" pod=$pod$
